app.title: SocketLens
onboarding.title: Welcome to SocketLens
onboarding.description: A local-first WebSocket debugging workspace. Start with the offline demo, then try a real local echo server and replay one packet.
onboarding.modes.demo.title: Demo Mode
onboarding.modes.demo.description: Offline flow with no server. Best for first-run orientation and demos.
onboarding.modes.direct.title: Direct Mode
onboarding.modes.direct.description: SocketLens connects to a ws:// or wss:// endpoint itself and can send frames.
onboarding.modes.proxy.title: Proxy Mode
onboarding.modes.proxy.description: Your app connects through a local SocketLens proxy. Requires desktop/Tauri.
onboarding.concepts.inspector.title: Payload inspector
onboarding.concepts.inspector.descriptio: Select a packet to read Pretty, Raw, and Metadata without stopping the stream.
onboarding.concepts.replay.title: Replay
onboarding.concepts.replay.description: Send a previous outbound frame again through the active connection.
onboarding.twoMinutes.title: Try SocketLens in 2 minutes
onboarding.twoMinutes.description: Steps complete automatically when SocketLens sees real packets and replay. Start the echo-server command manually in a terminal.
onboarding.startHere.demo.title: Start the guided demo
onboarding.startHere.demo.description: No setup. See packets, inspector, replay, and AI preview with simulated traffic.
onboarding.startHere.echo.title: Run a real local server
onboarding.startHere.echo.description: Open a second terminal from the repository root and start the echo-server.
onboarding.startHere.connect.title: Connect and send ping
onboarding.startHere.connect.description: Use Direct Mode, send {"command":"ping"}, then inspect the response.
onboarding.actions.title: Quick actions
onboarding.actions.description: SocketLens only connects, sends, or replays traffic when you click the matching action.
onboarding.steps.startDemo.title: Start demo
onboarding.steps.startDemo.subtitle: SocketLens creates safe synthetic traffic without connecting to a server.
onboarding.steps.viewTimeline.title: View packet timeline
onboarding.steps.viewTimeline.subtitle: Inbound and outbound WebSocket frames appear in the center timeline.
onboarding.steps.selectPacket.title: Select a packet
onboarding.steps.selectPacket.subtitle: Click any timeline row to focus a specific payload.
onboarding.steps.openInspector.title: Open inspector
onboarding.steps.openInspector.subtitle: Pretty, Raw, and Metadata views appear on the right for the selected packet.
onboarding.steps.startEcho.title: Start echo-server
onboarding.steps.startEcho.subtitle: Open a second terminal at the repository root and start a real WebSocket endpoint.
onboarding.steps.connectEcho.title: Connect to localhost
onboarding.steps.connectEcho.subtitle: Direct Mode connects to the local echo server and starts receiving messages.
onboarding.steps.sendPing.title: Send ping
onboarding.steps.sendPing.subtitle: SocketLens sends a real outbound JSON frame over the active WebSocket connection.
onboarding.steps.observePong.title: Observe response
onboarding.steps.observePong.subtitle: The echo server returns command.pong, and the response appears as an inbound packet.
onboarding.steps.replay.title: Replay packet
onboarding.steps.replay.subtitle: Replay sends the previous ping again through the active connection.

sidebar.demoMode.description: Continuous synthetic traffic for testing the timeline.

sidebar.directConnectionEmptyHelp: Create a ws:// endpoint for a real server. For a quick first run, use demo above.
sidebar.quickEcho.title: Quick connect: echo-server
sidebar.quickEcho.description: Start the local echo-server in a terminal, then connect here. SocketLens creates a saved direct connection and opens it immediately.
sidebar.directStatus.waitingForPackets: Waiting for packets. Send your first message from Manual send below.
sidebar.directStatus.connectingDescripti: SocketLens is opening a direct WebSocket connection. No packets are captured until the socket opens.
sidebar.directStatus.errorHint: For the local echo-server, run npm run dev:echo in a second terminal and reconnect to ws://127.0.0.1:17787.
sidebar.directStatus.idleDescription: Connect to a WebSocket endpoint, then choose an example payload and click Send frame.
sidebar.directHistoryEmpty: Only real WebSocket endpoints appear here, not demo:// sessions.
sidebar.noSessions.title: No sessions yet
sidebar.noSessions.description: Connect to an endpoint to create the first session.
connectionModal.title: New connection
connectionModal.description: Save a WebSocket endpoint to your local history.

packets.title: Packet timeline
packets.description: Incoming and outgoing WebSocket frames appear here.
packets.empty.title: No packets yet - this is normal
packets.empty.description: Start Investor Demo for an offline tour, or run npm run dev:echo and connect to ws://127.0.0.1:17787 for real traffic.
packets.empty.waitingDescription: The WebSocket is open. SocketLens is ready to capture inbound and outbound frames.
packets.empty.errorDescription: No packets were captured before the connection failed. Check the URL, start the server, and reconnect.
packets.empty.hints.demo.title: 1. Start demo
packets.empty.hints.demo.description: Best first click. Works offline and fills the timeline immediately.
packets.empty.hints.echo.title: 2. Echo-server
packets.empty.hints.echo.description: Run npm run dev:echo in a second terminal.
packets.empty.hints.connect.title: 3. Direct Mode
packets.empty.hints.connect.description: Connect to ws://127.0.0.1:17787 and send ping.
packets.empty.filteredDescription: Clear filters or adjust the search query to reveal captured packets.
packets.previewHidden: Payload preview hidden by privacy settings.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Local preferences for the SocketLens desktop workspace.
settings.onboarding.restartToastMessage: Return to the workspace to see the first-run guide again.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Switch the application interface language. Captured payloads, JSON, URLs, logs from traffic, and session files are not translated.
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.description: Choose the visual density and how the workspace follows live packets.
settings.compactMode.description: Reduces the global interface scale for dense packet sessions.
settings.autoScroll.description: New timeline views start pinned to the newest packet.
settings.workspace.title: Workspace
settings.workspace.description: Keep high-volume packet sessions predictable without changing how SocketLens starts.
settings.packetRetention.description: When the limit is reached, SocketLens keeps the newest packets and clears the oldest retained packets from memory.
settings.ai.title: AI Provider
settings.ai.description: AI analysis is optional and disabled by default. Packet data is sent only when you run an AI action.
settings.ai.privacyDescription: AI actions send selected packet or session excerpts to the configured provider. Leave AI disabled if captured traffic contains secrets, personal data, customer content, or production credentials.
settings.ai.disabledDescription: SocketLens works fully without AI. No packet data is sent to an AI provider while this setting is active.
settings.ai.ollamaModels.hint: Enter a model manually or load the list from local Ollama.
settings.ai.ollamaModels.empty: Ollama responded, but no models were found. Install a model with `ollama pull <model>`.
settings.ai.ollamaModels.errors.unreacha: Could not connect to Ollama at {{baseUrl}}. Make sure Ollama is running, the model is installed, and browser access is allowed.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy
settings.privacy.description: Privacy defaults are local-first and explicit. Captured payloads stay in memory unless you save or export a session.
settings.privacy.localFirstDescription: SocketLens does not send telemetry, captured payloads, URLs, or session files to SocketLens servers. Data leaves this app only when you connect to a WebSocket endpoint, run proxy mode, explicitly save/export/copy data, or click an AI action with a configured provider.
settings.privacy.persistConnectionsDescr: Stores recent WebSocket endpoint names and URLs in local app storage.
settings.privacy.payloadPreviewsDescript: When disabled, timeline rows hide payload previews while packet inspection still works after selection.
logs.title: Logs
inspector.title: Payload inspector
inspector.empty: Select a packet to inspect payload details.
inspector.emptySelection.title: Select a packet
inspector.emptySelection.description: Pretty, raw, and metadata views will appear here without interrupting the packet stream.
inspector.notices.prettyTruncated: Pretty output is truncated in the UI. Copy still uses the full payload.
inspector.notices.rawTruncated: Raw payload is truncated in the UI. Copy still uses the full payload.
inspector.prettyMessages.not-json: Pretty view is available for JSON payloads. Use Raw for this packet.
inspector.prettyMessages.large-json: This JSON payload is large. Raw view is shown without expensive formatting.
inspector.prettyMessages.invalid-json: Payload is marked as JSON but could not be parsed safely.
manualSend.title: Manual send
manualSend.examples.title: Example payloads
manualSend.examples.description: Load an example, then click Send frame. The local echo-server understands ping and echoes the other examples.
manualSend.previousOutgoingEmpty: Sent frames will appear here for editing and replay.
manualSend.replayHistoryEmpty: Successful sends and replays are recorded here.
manualSend.errors.invalidJson: Payload is not valid JSON. Switch to Raw text or fix the JSON before sending.
manualSend.errors.connectBeforeReplayPac: Connect to a WebSocket before replaying packets.
manualSend.errors.connectBeforeReplayHis: Connect to a WebSocket before replaying history items.
proxy.title: Proxy capture
proxy.description: External clients connect to a local SocketLens URL. Frames are forwarded to the target and captured here.
proxy.localProxyUrlEmpty: Start proxy to generate a local URL
proxy.nativeRequired: Proxy capture runs in the Rust/Tauri backend. Start SocketLens with npm run dev:desktop; browser dev mode can edit the UI but cannot bind a local proxy port.
proxy.limitations.title: Alpha limitations
proxy.limitations.desktop: Proxy mode requires the native desktop app; browser dev mode cannot accept external clients.
proxy.limitations.localhost: The local proxy binds to 127.0.0.1 and is intended for local debugging.
proxy.limitations.frames: Text, JSON, binary, ping/pong, close, and error paths are handled; advanced auth/header rewriting is not included yet.
proxy.toasts.stoppedDescription: External clients can no longer connect through SocketLens.
proxy.logs.started: Proxy started at {{url}}. Point an external client at this URL.
proxy.errors.copyFailed: Could not copy proxy URL. Select and copy it manually.
proxy.errors.nativeUnavailable: Proxy mode is unavailable in browser development mode. Start the native app with npm run dev:desktop.
proxy.errors.alreadyRunning: Proxy mode is already running. Stop the current proxy before starting another one.
proxy.errors.bindFailed: Could not bind the local proxy listener.
proxy.errors.runtime: Proxy runtime failed while forwarding frames.
sessions.files.title: Session files
sessions.files.description: Save or import captured debug sessions.
sessions.files.nativeStorage: Desktop mode uses native Tauri file dialogs and filesystem access.
sessions.files.browserStorage: Browser dev mode uses a JSON download/upload fallback instead of native filesystem access.
sessions.logs.saveNeedsSession: Create or import a session before saving a session file.
sessions.logs.exportNeedsPackets: Capture or import packets before exporting packet JSON.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
retention.title: Memory
retention.description: Oldest packets are cleared automatically when the retained timeline reaches the limit.
retention.messages.limitSet: Packet retention limit set to {{count}} packets.
ai.title: AI explain packet
ai.description: Optional. Sends data only when you click Explain.
ai.privacyCopy: The selected packet payload and metadata are sent to your configured provider only after you click Explain.
ai.empty: Select a packet in the timeline to enable explanation.
ai.loading: Asking {{provider}} to explain the selected packet. SocketLens remains usable while the provider responds.
ai.errors.noPacket: Select a packet before asking AI to explain it.
ai.errors.disabled: AI analysis is disabled. Enable a provider in Settings to explain packets.
ai.errors.ollamaNetwork: Could not connect to Ollama at {{baseUrl}}. Make sure Ollama is running, the model is installed, and browser access is allowed.
ai.errors.openAiNetwork: Could not connect to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint at {{baseUrl}}. Check the URL, network, and CORS/app access.
ai.providerState.disabled: AI is disabled in Settings. SocketLens works fully without AI.
ai.demo.suspiciousSignal: The packet contains an error or warning signal. In this demo it is expected and safe to retry after backoff.
ai.demo.noSuspiciousSignal: No obvious suspicious error signal is visible in this selected demo packet.
ai.demo.markdown.title: Demo packet explanation
ai.demo.markdown.likelyPurpose: This packet appears to participate in the guided Investor Demo flow. It is synthetic offline traffic, not production capture.
ai.demo.markdown.confidence: Medium. This is a deterministic demo explanation and does not claim certainty about real systems.
ai.demo.payload.validJsonNotObject: The payload is valid JSON but not an object.
ai.demo.payload.notJson: The payload is not valid JSON, so the raw body should be inspected directly.
investorDemo.heroTitleActive: Watch the guided WebSocket story unfold
investorDemo.heroTitleComplete: Demo traffic is ready to inspect
investorDemo.heroDescription: Synthetic LaunchRoom traffic walks through auth, chat, presence, notifications, heartbeat, reconnect, an error path, AI-like streaming, and replay without contacting any production service.
investorDemo.privacyLine: Clearly marked demo traffic. No packets leave the app unless you explicitly use a configured AI provider.
investorDemo.walkthrough.simulated.label: Simulated
investorDemo.walkthrough.simulated.title: Offline story
investorDemo.walkthrough.simulated.descr: Every generated packet includes demo metadata. No production endpoint is contacted.
investorDemo.walkthrough.highlight.label: Focus
investorDemo.walkthrough.highlight.title: Watch the highlighted frame
investorDemo.walkthrough.inspect.label: Inspector
investorDemo.walkthrough.inspect.title: Select and inspect
investorDemo.sidebarDescription: Guided offline WebSocket story for first-run demos.
SocketLens opens with a synthetic realtime app handshake so the workspace has useful traffic immediately.
Inspect the challenge response to see expiry, cluster, and simulated demo metadata.
investorDemo.steps.auth-flow.title: Auth flow is visible
investorDemo.steps.auth-flow.description: The demo follows a believable login exchange with workspace scopes and a clear accepted session.
investorDemo.steps.auth-flow.inspectHint: The inspector shows user, workspace, entitlements, expiry, and the exact event name.
investorDemo.steps.chat-traffic.title: Live chat traffic appears
investorDemo.steps.chat-traffic.descript: A chat room snapshot, a sent message, and server fan-out packets make the timeline feel like a real product session.
investorDemo.steps.chat-traffic.inspectH: Open the payload to compare the outbound message with server delivery and fan-out metadata.
investorDemo.steps.heartbeat.title: Heartbeat stays clean
investorDemo.steps.heartbeat.description: Heartbeat frames prove the connection is alive and help developers reason about latency and reconnect behavior.
investorDemo.steps.heartbeat.inspectHint: Inspect ping/pong timing, clock skew, and connection health without pausing the stream.
investorDemo.steps.reconnect-event.title: Reconnect is visible
investorDemo.steps.reconnect-event.descr: A short network blip demonstrates reconnect visibility without pretending that production traffic is involved.
investorDemo.steps.reconnect-event.inspe: Inspect the resume token preview, downtime, recovered events, and new socket id.
investorDemo.steps.presence-events.title: Presence is separated
investorDemo.steps.presence-events.descr: Presence changes show collaborators moving through the same realtime room without mixing them with chat messages.
investorDemo.steps.presence-events.inspe: Inspect who is online, typing, or moving a cursor while chat packets remain separate.
investorDemo.steps.notifications.title: Notifications are inspectable
investorDemo.steps.notifications.descrip: Notifications show route, priority, audience, and actions as inspectable payload data.
investorDemo.steps.notifications.inspect: The selected packet shows notification routing, action data, audience, and receive time.
investorDemo.steps.error-event.title: Errors are friendly
investorDemo.steps.error-event.descripti: The timeline includes a safe warning packet so the inspector and AI demo can explain a suspicious event without crashing.
investorDemo.steps.error-event.inspectHi: The inspector keeps the warning readable and shows retry advice instead of crashing.
investorDemo.steps.ai-streaming-response: A simulated AI-style streaming response shows how chunked realtime output can be inspected without calling an AI provider.
Inspect each delta chunk and the final summary; providerCalled remains false in the demo.
investorDemo.steps.replay-example.title: Replay is demonstrated
investorDemo.steps.replay-example.descri: SocketLens shows the original outbound frame and a replayed version in history, clearly marked as demo traffic.
investorDemo.steps.replay-example.inspec: The selected response proves the replayed acknowledgement was accepted and recorded in history.
investorDemo.steps.ai-placeholder.title: AI explain preview is offline
investorDemo.steps.ai-placeholder.descri: When AI is disabled, SocketLens shows an offline demo explanation so the privacy model stays honest.
investorDemo.steps.ai-placeholder.inspec: The AI panel can show a local demo explanation without calling any provider.

investorDemo.toasts.resetDescription: The guided demo timeline and replay history were reset.
investorDemo.toasts.completedDescription: The guided packet story is ready to inspect, including replay history and the offline AI explain sample.

errors.websocket.empty: Enter a WebSocket URL before connecting.
errors.websocket.protocol: Endpoint must start with ws:// or wss://.
errors.websocket.fragment: WebSocket URLs cannot include URL fragments.
errors.websocket.host: WebSocket URL must include a host.
errors.websocket.invalid: Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// endpoint.
errors.ai.disabled: AI is disabled. SocketLens will not send packet data to an AI provider.
errors.ai.openaiBaseUrlMissing: Enter a base URL for the OpenAI-compatible provider.
errors.ai.openaiBaseUrlInvalid: OpenAI-compatible base URL must start with http:// or https://.
errors.ai.openaiModelMissing: Enter a model name for the OpenAI-compatible provider.
errors.ai.openaiApiKeyMissing: Enter an API key. SocketLens stores it only in local app storage.
errors.ai.ollamaBaseUrlInvalid: Ollama base URL must start with http:// or https://.
errors.user.invalidUrl.title: Invalid WebSocket URL
errors.user.invalidUrl.message: The WebSocket URL is not valid.
errors.user.invalidUrl.suggestion: Use a full ws:// or wss:// URL. For a local check, start the echo-server and use ws://127.0.0.1:17787.
errors.user.connectionFailure.title: Connection failed
errors.user.connectionFailure.message: SocketLens could not keep the WebSocket connection open.
errors.user.connectionFailure.suggestion: Check that the server is running, the URL is correct, and then reconnect. For local echo, run npm run dev:echo.
errors.user.proxyUnavailable.title: Proxy unavailable
errors.user.proxyUnavailable.message: SocketLens could not start or control proxy mode.
errors.user.proxyUnavailable.suggestion: Use the desktop/Tauri app, check that the target server is reachable, and retry. If the port is busy, stop the other process or restart SocketLens.
errors.user.backendUnavailable.title: Native backend unavailable
errors.user.backendUnavailable.message: SocketLens cannot reach the native Tauri backend from this runtime.
errors.user.backendUnavailable.suggestio: Proxy mode and native file dialogs require desktop mode. Run npm run dev:desktop or use browser-safe Direct/Demo mode.
errors.user.malformedJson.title: Malformed JSON
errors.user.malformedJson.message: The payload is not valid JSON.
errors.user.malformedJson.suggestion: Fix the JSON syntax, use Format JSON again, or switch the composer to Raw text before sending.
errors.user.aiProviderUnavailable.title: AI provider unavailable
errors.user.aiProviderUnavailable.messag: SocketLens could not reach the configured AI provider.
errors.user.aiProviderUnavailable.sugges: Check provider settings, make sure Ollama or your OpenAI-compatible endpoint is running, then retry Explain.
errors.user.localFile.title: Session file problem
errors.user.localFile.message: SocketLens could not read or write the session file.
errors.user.localFile.suggestion: Choose a valid SocketLens JSON file and a writable location, then try again.
errors.user.unknown.title: Action needs attention
errors.user.unknown.message: SocketLens could not complete that action.
errors.user.unknown.suggestion: Check the diagnostics panel and retry the action. You can copy details for debugging.
ai.errors.noPacketSuggestion: Select a packet in the timeline first. SocketLens sends nothing until you click Explain.
ai.errors.disabledSuggestion: Enable OpenAI-compatible or Ollama in Settings to use AI. The app works normally while AI is disabled.
